feeds.title: Enter Shaolin Blog
feeds.description: Learn Kung Fu Online from the comfort of your home. Get free kung fu lessons delivered to your inbox. Finally learn the secrets there were passed down for generations. We cover Wing Chun, Tai Chi Chuan, Chin Na, Qigong, and many others.

feeds.title: Silent River Kung Fu Blog
feeds.description: News and musings from the instructors and students of Silent River Kung Fu. Follow our journey as we explore what it means to pursue mastery as cognizant, compassionate human beings.

feeds.title: Kung Fu Tea
feeds.description: Welcome to Kung Fu Tea, where we discuss all aspects of Chinese Martial Studies. Many of the posts here focus on the academic study of the Chinese martial arts, but occasionally we delve into lighter topics like current events, movies or martial arts in the news. From time to time I will also offer posts looking at other areas of interest to students of martial studies.

feeds.title: New Life Kung Fu Blog
feeds.description: New Life Kung Fu's purpose is to bring the great art of Chineses Shaolin Kung Fu to the Spartanburg South Carolina area. Shifu Don is committed to each students progress and has a personal interest in their training and development. Sifu Don feels that Kung Fu is an ever developing skill that keeps the body and mind in tip top shape.

feeds.title: Wing Chun Kung Fu Bendigo Blog
feeds.description: Learn self defence and build confidence and fitness with Wing Chun Kung Fu - a traditional Chinese martial art, right here in Bendigo!

feeds.title: Shaolin Treasure House Blog
feeds.description: Covers interesting information on genuine Shaolin training of Kung Fu, Qi Gong and Tai Chi. You will not find anything about summersaults and show performances here, but about combat application and the rare training of internal force which make the two pillars of traditional Kung Fu training. You'll get everything you need for your personal practice to improve your health, vitality and combat efficiency.

feeds.title: Kung Fu Dad
feeds.description: A place where people can talk about Kung Fu, Love, and where the two meet, and also stories in the book and how the relate to their experiences.

feeds.title: Southern Praying Mantis Kung Fu Blog
feeds.description: Kwong Sai Jook Lum Gee Tong Long Pai (Kwong Sai Province, Bamboo Forest Monastery Praying Mantis Family) is a martial art founded by Monk Sam Dot and passed down directly to Master Gin Foon Mark in an unbroken lineage. We emphasize real time application of the techniques and the foundation behind them. Here with the Philadelphia Pai, Joe is interested in teaching what works in the real world, in real time; not the theoretical.

feeds.title: Internal Kung Fu Blog
feeds.description: It has been a profound journey so far, a truly great experience and privilege to learn kung fu closely with my teacher Master Luo De Xiu. Learn more about Kung Fu techniques on my blog

feeds.title: Bo Law Kung Fu Blog
feeds.description: We are a traditional Kung Fu Academy looking for highly motivated men and women who are interested in improving themselves both physically, mentally and spiritually. At Bo Law Kung Fu, the competition is with yourself, not with others. The purpose of establishing Bo Law Kung Fu was to teach what its founder, Master Koh; feels is the true essence of Kung Fu: the training of body, mind, and spirit together in order to realize the true potential of one's self.

feeds.title: My Chow Gar Blog
feeds.description: My Chow Gar Blog is dedicated to preserving and promoting Chow Gar Kung Fu, offering extensive insights into this ancient martial art. The blog, led by experienced martial artists like Zoltán Bereczki, Bálint Vitárius, and Attila Baráth, shares the rich history and techniques of Chow Gar. It aims to make this powerful system accessible to enthusiasts worldwide through detailed articles and online training programs.
